integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with supplemental independently implemented finite checks; no independent external scientific validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for periodic integral corrections and one expanding root equal to the appending base; the finite-walk upper bound is not optimized, and conclusions do not cover general aperiodic corrections. Novelty is subject to inaccessible or implicit earlier material.
title: Sharp cyclic-gap thresholds for digit-appending walks on periodically perturbed powers
